verdict.rationale: Keycloak is a standards-based identity provider supporting OpenID Connect and OAuth 2.0. It publishes a well-known discovery endpoint listing its OIDC endpoints, lets developers register OIDC clients with redirect URIs through the admin console, and documents refresh-token handling via the introspection and revocation endpoints. Developers therefore rely on standard protocol endpoints rather than custom ones, though a community user notes it is hard to understand without prior OAuth/OIDC knowledge. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the authorization code flow and PKCE support, evidence of first-party client libraries/adapters that remove protocol handling, and independent hands-on corroboration of these flows.
